_comment: Pages the draft-update workflow reads (scripts/draft-update.mjs). Edit freely: name is shown as the source in flood.json; followLinks (0-4) opens that many flood-related article links found on the page, so each change can cite an article with its own publication time. {NAME} in a URL is filled in from a secret or variable of that name and never shown. Sources that can't be fetched are listed in the pull request.

sources.name: Thai Meteorological Department (warnings)
sources._note: TMD open-data warnings feed. {TMD_API_UID} (repository variable) and {TMD_API_KEY} (secret) come from a free registration at data.tmd.go.th; if either is missing this source is skipped and flagged. The tmd.go.th website itself sends an incomplete certificate chain, which Node rejects.
